items.summary: NEW: profile→DM button + launch on home feed (build 24)
items.text:
Have a feature or a button to open that person’s direct messages directly from the person’s profile. It would be great because after checking one’s profile if we have to message them, we have again go back and then get into the direct messages page. so having a button to quickly go to that person‘s direct messages while being on his or her profile would be great. 

Another one. When the app is being started rather than being on the camera page, being on the home feed would be better because opening the camera while the app is starting, would make the app a little bit laggier. So it would be the best if the app is on the homepage when it is opened.
